cv_bench.scope: All test 3D and only Relation from test 2D

3dsrbench.scope: All valid-column rows of the official circular TSV, grouped using the HiSpatial rule

execution: Per-benchmark answer-free parity probes compare cached and batched generation to the official single-query method, with automatic fallback to the exact single-query path on differences.
offline_scoring: Official scripts are replayed on sealed generation text with model and image/depth I/O replaced by stubs. Compare detailed per-question scoring with those official metrics. The GPU runner reads only projected questions, options, and images.
